meta.notes: A script on the item.use event that makes a breeze rod a staff. player.raycast(48) casts a ray from the eyes along the look and returns the block (or, unless entities is false, the mob) it hits first, so a plain use teleports the player onto the block looked at when there is room. Sneak-using it in the overworld stores the position in player.data; sneak-using it in another dimension teleports the player home, as teleport with the dimension option moves across dimensions. There is no way to make a position from numbers, so the script offsets the current one. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the Java project export leaves them out.
